milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the barrel and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The barrels are placed at spawn-relative coordinates (0, 1, 8), (2, 1, 8), and (-2, 1, 8). Target is set to the center barrel at (0, 1, 8) with max_distance=6 (increased from 5 per Validator/CommonSense feedback for robustness) and facing_tolerance=60 to model the player seeing the barrel.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate past the barrel area, turn left through the narrow opening, and face the magenta terracotta blocks. The terracotta is placed on the far wall at spawn-relative coordinates around (-5, 1, 12) (center of the wall section from (-5,1,10) to (-5,2,13)). Target is set to (-5, 1, 12) with max_distance=8 and facing_tolerance=60 to ensure the player has navigated into the alcove and is looking at the terracotta.
